```{r weather, fig.width=10, fig.height=6, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)
library(readr)


# Set file paths (change if necessary)
setwd("~/Github/MBRP")
file_mrc <- "data/CR1000_mrc_FifteenMinute.xlsx"
file_meter <- "data/MRC_weather(z6-28104)-Configuration 1-1744054176.082678.csv"

#file_mrc <- "data/CR1000_mrc_FifteenMinute.xlsx"
#file_meter <- "data/Meter_5min_z6-28104.csv"

# Read data from Excel
df_mrc <- read_excel(file_mrc, skip = 1)  # skip metadata rows
df_mrc <- df_mrc %>% slice(-1, -2)
df_meter <- read_csv(file_meter, skip = 2)

# Clean CR1000 data
df_mrc <- df_mrc %>%
  rename_with(~ gsub(" ", "_", .x)) %>%
  mutate(TIMESTAMP = ymd_hms(TIMESTAMP)) %>%
  select(
    TIMESTAMP,
    Temp = AirTC_1_Avg,
    Temp2 = AirTC_2_Avg,
    RH = RH_1,
    RH2 = RH_2,
    Solar = Solar1_kW_Avg,
    Solar2 = Solar2_kW_Avg,
    WindSpeed = WS_mph_S_WVT,
    WindDir = WindDir_D1_WVT,
    Rain = Rain_mm_Tot
  )

df_mrc <- df_mrc %>%
  mutate(
    Temp = as.numeric(Temp),
    Temp2 = as.numeric(Temp2),
    RH = as.numeric(RH),
    RH2 = as.numeric(RH2),
    Solar = as.numeric(Solar) * 1000,
    Solar2 = as.numeric(Solar2) * 1000,
    WindSpeed = as.numeric(WindSpeed) * 0.44704, 
    WindDir = as.numeric(WindDir), 
    Rain = as.numeric(Rain) 
  )


# Clean MRC weather data

df_meter <- df_meter %>%
  rename_with(~ gsub(" ", "_", .x)) %>%
  mutate(Timestamps = dmy_hms(Timestamps),
         es1 = 0.611 * exp((17.502 * `°C_RH_Sensor_Temp`) / (`°C_RH_Sensor_Temp` + 240.97)), #°C_Air_Temperature
         es2 = 0.611 * exp((17.502 * `°C_Air_Temperature`) / (`°C_Air_Temperature` + 240.97)), #°C_Air_Temperature
         RH1 = (`kPa_Vapor_Pressure` / es1) * 100,
         RH2 = (`kPa_Vapor_Pressure` / es2) * 100
    
  ) %>%
  select(
    Timestamps,
    MinTemp = `°C_Min_Air_Temperature`, # °C_Air_Temperature
    Temp = `°C_Air_Temperature`, # °C_Air_Temperature
    MaxTemp = `°C_Max_Air_Temperature`, # °C_Air_Temperature
    Solar = `W/m²_Solar_Radiation`,
    WindSpeed = `m/s_Wind_Speed`,
    WindDir = `°_Wind_Direction`,
    Rain = mm_Precipitation, 
    RH1 = RH1,
    RH2 = RH2
  ) 

# Assuming df_meter is your data frame
df_meter_15min <- df_meter %>%
  mutate(Timestamps = floor_date(Timestamps, "15 minutes")) %>%
  group_by(Timestamps) %>%
  summarise(
    Temp = mean(Temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    MinTemp = min(MinTemp, na.rm = TRUE),
    MaxTemp = max(MaxTemp, na.rm = TRUE),
    Solar = mean(Solar, na.rm = TRUE),
    WindSpeed = mean(WindSpeed, na.rm = TRUE),
    WindDir = mean(WindDir, na.rm = TRUE),
    Rain = mean(Rain, na.rm = TRUE),
    RH1 = mean(RH1, na.rm = TRUE),
    RH2 = mean(RH2, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Define station names as character variables
station_1 <- "MRC"
station_2 <- "METER"

#Rain
plot_ly() %>%
  add_lines(data = df_meter_15min, x = ~Timestamps, y = ~Rain, name = "METER", line = list(color = "blue")) %>%
  add_lines(data = df_mrc, x = ~TIMESTAMP, y = ~Rain, name = "MRC", line = list(color = "red")) %>%
  layout(yaxis = list(title = "Rainfall (mm)"))

#RH (Relative Humidity)
plot_ly() %>%
  add_lines(data = df_meter_15min, x = ~Timestamps, y = ~RH1, name = "METER sens", line = list(color = "lightblue")) %>%
  add_lines(data = df_meter_15min, x = ~Timestamps, y = ~RH2, name = "METER air", line = list(color = "darkblue")) %>%
  add_lines(data = df_mrc, x = ~TIMESTAMP, y = ~RH, name = "MRC1", line = list(color = "red")) %>%
  add_lines(data = df_mrc, x = ~TIMESTAMP, y = ~RH2, name = "MRC2", line = list(color = "darkred")) %>%
  layout(yaxis = list(title = "Relative Humidity %"))

#Temp (Temperature)
plot_ly() %>%
  add_lines(data = df_meter_15min, x = ~Timestamps, y = ~MaxTemp, name = "max METER", line = list(color = "darkblue")) %>%
  add_lines(data = df_meter_15min, x = ~Timestamps, y = ~Temp, name = "mean METER", line = list(color = "blue")) %>%
  add_lines(data = df_meter_15min, x = ~Timestamps, y = ~MinTemp, name = "min METER", line = list(color = "lightblue")) %>%
  add_lines(data = df_mrc, x = ~TIMESTAMP, y = ~Temp, name = "MRC1", line = list(color = "red")) %>%
  add_lines(data = df_mrc, x = ~TIMESTAMP, y = ~Temp2, name = "MRC2", line = list(color = "darkred")) %>%
  layout(yaxis = list(title = "Temperature °C"))

#Solar
plot_ly() %>%
  add_lines(data = df_meter_15min, x = ~Timestamps, y = ~Solar, name = "METER", line = list(color = "blue")) %>%
  add_lines(data = df_mrc, x = ~TIMESTAMP, y = ~Solar, name = "MRC1", line = list(color = "red")) %>%
  add_lines(data = df_mrc, x = ~TIMESTAMP, y = ~Solar2, name = "MRC2", line = list(color = "darkred")) %>%
  layout(yaxis = list(title = "Solar Radiation W/m^2"))

#WindSpeed
plot_ly() %>%
  add_lines(data = df_meter_15min, x = ~Timestamps, y = ~WindSpeed, name = "METER", line = list(color = "blue")) %>%
  add_lines(data = df_mrc, x = ~TIMESTAMP, y = ~WindSpeed, name = "MRC", line = list(color = "red")) %>%
  layout(yaxis = list(title = "Wind Speed m/s"))

#WindDir
plot_ly() %>%
  add_lines(data = df_meter_15min, x = ~Timestamps, y = ~WindDir, name = "METER", line = list(color = "blue")) %>%
  add_lines(data = df_mrc, x = ~TIMESTAMP, y = ~WindDir, name = "MRC", line = list(color = "red")) %>%
  layout(yaxis = list(title = "Wind Direction"))

```
